title: The 1 Percent Rule for Building Better Habits: Small Steps That Last
description: The 1 Percent Rule for Building Better Habits shows how tiny daily improvements can create sustainable change without overwhelming routines. Learn how small actions, consistency, and behavior formation help build stronger habits over time. This guide explains why progress beats perfection, how manageable steps reduce resistance, and how daily systems shape personal growth. Save this pin for later.
alt_text: An infographic explaining The 1 Percent Rule for Building Better Habits with visual sections showing small daily improvements, consistent actions, habit formation, and progress over perfection.
image_teaser_points: Small, manageable improvements create lasting progress
Tiny actions become powerful through repetition and consistency
Goals provide direction, but habits create movement
Small steps reduce resistance and make behaviors easier to maintain
